note: Inyo NF campground just east of US-395 at Tom's Place, on three gravel loops in sage and Jeffrey pine below the tuff formations, beside Lower Rock Creek; often among the first in the Rock Creek area to open in spring. --Claude
summary: rec.gov description/rules/rates/catalog/calendar + FS page read. $33 confirmed, extra vehicle $10; 34 sites (rec.gov catalog 33), 001-012 FCFS, max 45 ft; weekend 2 / holiday 3 (soft) minimums, 4-day cutoff, 14-night max; season Apr 23 - Oct 24 from the calendar; potable water, vault toilets, no electric confirmed. Pin ~310 m to the FS point. Waterfront left not waterfront (creekside lead).
flags: PIN MOVE (~310 m): stored 37.56260,-118.66480 sits at the east end of the campground road past site 031; target 37.5623,-118.6683 (FS page's Latitude/Longitude, which matches the centroid of the 33 rec.gov site points).

WATERFRONT LEAD (creekside, not changed): stored evidence says 'Rock Creek is incised in a gorge south across US-395', but rec.gov says 'Some campsites sit in the shade along Rock Creek' and 'Rock Creek runs alongside the campsites', and USGS NHD puts Lower Rock Creek 31-38 m from sites 029, 030, 031 and 021 (all reservable, 30-40 ft except 021 at 25 ft) and 43-60 m from 010, 012, 017-022, 028, 032-034. The creek is under a continuous pine/aspen band on Esri and not visible, and the NHD line is not precise enough to put a site at the bank, so it stays not waterfront by default; a site photo or ground read of sites 029-031 could earn creekside. The stored evidence line about a gorge across US-395 is wrong and should be replaced with this.
SITE COUNT CONFLICT: FS page '34 campsites'; rec.gov catalog has 33 (no site 011). Kept 34.
RIG WORDING: rec.gov description says 'There is space for small trailers and RVs', but the catalog lists 25-45 ft for every site (30 of 33 at 30 ft+); not a fit problem.
